sources.quote:
You can now use cached prompt to save on repeated prompts. For
more info, see [models](/developers/models).
sources.supports: xAI announced cached prompt functionality in May 2025, before both models.dev observations; it does not state the Grok 3 Fast cache price.

sources.quote: The caching is automatically enabled for all requests without user input.
sources.supports: xAI documentation describes prompt caching, but this later snapshot provides no historical Grok 3 Fast cache price or effective date.

notes: The official sources found confirm that prompt caching existed by May 2025, but they do not establish whether the earlier models.dev record omitted an official Grok 3 Fast cache price or whether the June 17 addition reflected a provider price change. The Internet Archive CDX query for xAI pricing returned no matching snapshot and subsequent requests were unavailable, so no pricing bracket or effective date can be stated.
